svg.title: Browser to model: session setup, safety gates, release and reset
svg.desc: Browser to model: session setup, safety gates, release and reset. Boundaries describe application responsibilities; model judgments remain fallible.

g.text: Browser to model: session setup, safety gates, release and reset
HttpOnly cookie; CSRF token; accepted history
validate Host, Origin, session, CSRF, language
bound body before parsing; reject extra fields
static reply; no model call or memory commit
Safety net: context and input review
reduce risks, drinks scope, name, uncertainty
fixed drinks + specialist + selected language instructions
static fallback; no output judge or commit
render plain text; retain failed request for retry
delete idle conversation; create new one
retain server owner and rate history
Three calls on a successful turn.
Separate judge and shared specialist generation circuits.
Auditor is evaluation-only with a separate circuit.
Failures and invalid evidence fail closed.
Cookie identifies an anonymous local browser, not a verified person.
Process-local state expires and disappears on server restart.
No public identity service or shared distributed quotas are deployed.
Agentic Drink Book | Policy 2.1.0 | Model judgments remain fallible
